description: This file defines an immutable data class 'LoanScheduleData' in Java, representing aspects of a loan schedule such as total amounts, repayment schedule, and associated currency. It contains fields for various financial totals and a collection of period-specific data objects, along with constructors and a method to update future periods.

classes.name: LoanScheduleData
classes.description: Immutable data object to represent aspects of a loan schedule including totals and repayment periods.

methods.name: LoanScheduleData
methods.description: Constructor to initialize all fields with provided values, representing the final state of the loan schedule.

methods.name: updateFuturePeriods
methods.description: Method to update the 'futurePeriods' collection with new period data.
